notes_for_editor: Thin record. The survey and the Forest Lookouts list place the tower in Robertson County, Division of Forestry District 6; no build date, design, staffing, fire, or removal date was found. Wikipedia's Cross Plains article was read and does not mention a tower. The 1976 list PDF linked from the survey returned no readable text. The record's coordinates come from the survey; no NGS mark was found for this site.
